Interface IEventBus

All Known Implementing Classes:
ViewEventBus
public interface IEventBus
Event bus interface for the view layer.

Allows objects to subscribe to and receive ViewEvents. Once registered, a subscriber's methods annotated with Subscribe are invoked whenever a matching event is posted. Threading guarantees depend on the implementation.

  • Method Details

    • register

      boolean register(Object obj)
      Registers an object as a subscriber to this event bus. Once registered, the object's methods annotated with Subscribe will be invoked when a matching ViewEvent is posted.
      Parameters:
      obj - the subscriber to register
      Returns:
      true if the subscriber was added; false if already registered

    • unregister

      boolean unregister(Object obj)
      Removes an object from this event bus, stopping it from receiving further events. Must be called when a scene or component is unmounted to prevent stale listeners.
      Parameters:
      obj - the subscriber to remove
      Returns:
      true if the subscriber was removed; false if it was not registered

    • post

      void post(ViewEvent event)
      Dispatches a ViewEvent to all registered subscribers. Each subscriber whose handler method is annotated with Subscribe and whose parameter type matches the runtime type of event will be invoked.
      Parameters:
      event - the event to dispatch
